role_permissions_select.name: role_permissions_select
role_permissions_select.using: exists (select 1 from roles r where r.id = role_permissions.role_id)

roles_select.name: roles_select
roles_select.using: organization_id is null or organization_id = (select app.current_org_id())

organizations_select.name: organizations_select
organizations_select.using:
id = (select app.current_org_id()) or exists (
        select 1 from organization_memberships m
        where m.organization_id = organizations.id
          and m.user_id = (select app.current_user_id())
          and m.status = 'active'
      )
